company.name: Ultra
company.shortDescription: Ultra is an online shop to buy wine, liquor and beer.
company.description:
Ultra is a platform for alcohol retailers and related products to sell and deliver their products to customers usually within 1 hour. Currently our network covers NYC, North Jersey, Chicago, Washington DC and expanding to 20 additional cities.

Our customers can be broadly grouped in following categories:
1. Personal Consumption: People between the ages of 23-45 years ordering alcohol for personal consumption
2. Gift Orders: People sending alcohol as a gift to friends, family or business partners
3. Events: People ordering alcohol for personal, professional and client events

productsAndServices.description: Provides delivery of wine, liquor, and beer to homes, offices, and events in New York City with options for 1-hour and same-day delivery.

productsAndServices.description: Allows customers to send alcohol gifts to multiple addresses with scheduled delivery from 60 minutes up to 30 days, including gift notes and careful packaging.
